question: Please list the name of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost.
evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T1.name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.convertedManaCost DESC) AS __r FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap') AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' ORDER BY T1.convertedManaCost DESC LIMIT 1

b.request: List the name of every card in the set named 'Coldsnap' whose converted mana cost equals the maximum converted mana cost among all cards in that set, including all cards that tie for that maximum
b.sql: SELECT c.name FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND c.convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost) FROM cards c2 JOIN sets s2 ON c2.setCode = s2.code WHERE s2.name = 'Coldsnap')

d.request: Please list the name of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost, and if several cards tie for the highest converted mana cost, return all of them.
d.sql: SELECT c.name FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND c.convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost) FROM cards c2 JOIN sets s2 ON c2.setCode = s2.code WHERE s2.name = 'Coldsnap')

c.request:
Please list the name of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost.
Evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'
If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
c.sql: SELECT name FROM cards WHERE setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap') AND convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) FROM cards WHERE setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap'))
